🚀 witr | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Troubleshooting and understanding the root cause of running processes, services, and resource usage on a system.
✨ Key Features: • Trace process, port, container, or file origins • Answers "Why is this running?" • Provides human-readable reports • Outputs machine-readable JSON for scripts and AI agents • Interactive TUI dashboard
📖 Summary: witr is a command-line and TUI tool that traces the origin of running processes, ports, containers, and files. It answers the question "Why is this running?" by mapping entities back to their originating PID and detailing their ancestry, context, and dependencies, providing output in human-readable reports or machine-readable JSON.
